name: Physical Exercise
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of strength both physically and spiritually, emphasizing that true strength comes from wisdom and reliance on God. Proverbs illustrates the value of physical vigor through diligent effort, as seen in the woman who strengthens her arms and girds her loins. Isaiah reminds believers that God’s everlasting power renews the strength of those who trust in Him, enabling them to endure without weariness. Ultimately, the New Testament calls Christians to present their bodies as living sacrifices, empowered through Christ who strengthens them to face all challenges.
